hunks.sol: I leaned my chair far back and gazed at the white ceiling, keeping my voice calm.

hunks.sol: “You’ve been tough enough to make it this far, somehow… But what happens when it goes on for fifty years? Well, at least you’ll stay healthy. They’ll shower you with potions after every round of cutting.”
